## Personal Profile

I am a research assistant at Tsinghua University, working on AI for Science at the intersection of genomics and large language models (LLMs), with a focus on studying gene evolution. I earned a B.Eng. in Computer Science from Chongqing Univ. of Posts and Telecommunications in 2026 and will begin a CS Ph.D. at Penn State University (PSU) in Spring 2027. Previously, I was an LLM algorithm intern at Li Auto. I also work on co‑evolving documentation for coding agents (CoEvoDoc) and behavior‑oriented persona learning with Prof. Lu Cheng (PSU).

My interests include **AI for Science and genomics**, **human‑centered HCI**, **agentic/multi‑step reasoning**, **interpretability/controllability**, **self‑evolving systems**, and **multimodal pipelines**.
